name: Peerbound
description:
Peerbound is the AI-native customer intelligence platform. It listens across customer calls, G2 reviews, and existing customer stories to surface the quotes and stats your revenue team needs, then puts them where reps already work.

This connector brings that library into Claude. Instead of digging through folders or pinging customer marketing, ask for the proof you need and get it back with the source attached.

What you can do:
- Find proof for a specific deal. Describe the prospect, objection, or use case and get back the quotes, stories, and reviews that speak to it.
- Look up any account. Resolve a company by name or domain, then pull its details, stories, and reviews.
- Find lookalike customers. Surface accounts similar to your target by industry, size, and region. It's the "someone like my prospect" search.
- Search everything. Query customer quotes, full stories, and G2 reviews with filters for industry, use case, persona, and more.
- Cite the original. Pull any story, quote, or review with its full context and attribution intact.

Where it helps

- Personalizing outbound and follow-ups
- Prepping for a call, QBR, or exec briefing
- Building decks, one-pagers, and battlecards
- Answering RFPs with real customer evidence
- Grounding competitive positioning in what customers actually said

_published_faq.name: How do I add Peerbound to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Peerbound to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.peerbound.com/api/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Peerbound MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Peerbound provides these MCP tools: get_account_details, get_customer_story, get_g2_review, get_moment, resolve_account, search_customer_stories, search_moments, search_reviews, and suggest_proof.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Peerbound?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Peerbound in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.
Peerbound requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Peerbound is developed by Peerbound. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
